verdict_convention: Judge pre-inversion yes/no. Negated EF/AQ items record whether the named flaw is present, not the post-inversion score.

identifies_the_mechanism.rationale: Root cause does not name unlimited non-backoff retries on shared slots.

separates_trigger_from_cause.rationale: Does not explain why a six-minute 503 lasted until 07:03.

grounded_in_evidence.rationale: No causal claim is tied to two distinct evidence files.

rules_out_the_decoys.rationale: v2.8.1 is not explicitly ruled out with the healthy 02:47–03:11 queue.

separates_contributing_factors.rationale: Contributing factors are missing, generic, or restated cause.

uncertainty_is_genuine.rationale: Open questions are empty, filler, or already answered.

bounds_the_amplification.rationale: No action caps retries, adds backoff/DLQ, isolates retry slots, or breaks the gateway.

closes_the_detection_gap.rationale: No action re-routes queue-depth or pages on lag/retry/slots.

actions_are_actionable.rationale: Actions are absent, TBD, or generic advice.

actions_trace_to_findings.rationale: Actions are missing or disconnected from findings.

proposes_unsupported_work.rationale: No rollback of v2.8.1, vendor replacement, or db resize is proposed.

blames_the_deploy.rationale: v2.8.1 is not treated as a cause.

treats_db_cpu_as_cause.rationale: DB CPU is not treated as a cause.

misstates_a_fact.rationale: No specific value disagrees with the evidence files.

invents_evidence.rationale: No invented people, tickets, or metrics are cited.
